title: Unfolded size at a gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct input vertices, whose NOT gates each have exactly one input, and whose gates each have at most two input vertices. For any gate index $k$ within the gate list, the size obtained by unfolding the vertex corresponding to gate $k$ is at most $3$ plus the sum of the unfolded sizes of the distinct gate-input vertices of that gate (those with index at least the number of input variables).
hypotheses_covered: Every gate has pairwise distinct input vertices
Every NOT gate has exactly one input
Every gate has at most two input vertices
The index $k$ is less than the number of gates
